About Iman Ektesabi

My love for design started with computers and storytelling. As a kid, I loved exploring digital tools, writing stories, and creating worlds of my own.

Before product design, I worked in cinema as a videographer, behind the scenes photographer, documentary editor, colorist, and visual effects artist. I also acted in theatre. Storytelling, composition, and rhythm still shape how I approach design today.

I’m now a Product Design Engineer with 7 years of product design experience across B2B and B2C. My core expertise is AI business solutions, including call center platforms, AI agents, and AI-powered quality control. I’ve designed complex SaaS products, dashboards, and design systems, and built B2C products. I also present and defend design decisions, build client confidence, and deliver clear developer handoffs.

My work spans Web3 and DeFi, conversational AI, video streaming platforms, influencer platforms, and event ticketing.
